layout_observed: Circuit of the Americas 5.513km/20-corner Grand Prix layout.
lighting_weather_observed: Bright daytime with scattered clouds; some qualifying shots warmer/overcast.
review_scope: 16 sparse overview frames viewed by author. Clip is an edited career/race montage, includes menus/cuts and changing conditions; not a continuous lap. Unviewed timestamps are not evidence.

reviewed_visual_evidence.notes: Main straight, uphill T1 and T2: Long main-stand/pit complex, steep uphill blind T1 crest, spectator hill and low broadleaf trees. Wide asphalt/painted runoff and US flag geometry; opening hill must be real mesh relief.

T3–T10 esses: Rolling linked esses through grassy banks and sparse broadleaf woodland. Spectators on crests, open horizon, red/white kerbs and red/white/blue geometric runoff only on actual outside aprons.

T3–T10 esses: Rolling linked esses through grassy banks and sparse broadleaf woodland. Spectators on crests, open horizon, red/white kerbs and red/white/blue geometric runoff only on actual outside aprons.
T11 hairpin: Broad slow hairpin with large red/white apex treatment, outside paved escape, broad grass and low tree line; no close urban wall.
Back straight to T12: Long cresting straight, wide grass verges, square timing/advertising structures and large braking-zone apron. Stand mass beyond T12; sparse low service buildings.

T13–T15 stadium: Low bowl grandstands and broad coloured paved aprons. Red tubular observation-tower spine/curved cantilever crown rises beyond T16–18 and amphitheatre, not arbitrary roadside position.

T16–T18 triple right: Distinctive broad red/white/blue runoff, low trees and temporary bleachers, steel advertising bridges. Tower and amphitheatre compound dominate infield skyline.
T19, T20 and pit return: Wide final painted aprons, grass islands, multi-tier main-straight roof and long white pit bar; catch fences and viewing decks, distant observation wheel.
